channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após reunião com Lula, Jaques anuncia afastamento da liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: Senate government leader Jaques Wagner announced his resignation from the post following a meeting with President Lula, by mutual agreement, to focus on proving his innocence in the 9th phase of the Compliance Zero operation, a PF investigation into a billion-dollar financial fraud scheme involving Banco Master. He stated his priority is clearing his name and supporting the reelection of Lula, Jerônimo Rodrigues, and his own Senate re-election bid alongside Rui Costa.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula decide se mantém Wagner na liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Senator Jaques Wagner to decide whether Wagner will remain as the government leader in the Senate, following Wagner being targeted in the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police. The investigation examines alleged receipt of improper advantages to benefit private interests. The meeting was discussed on the Papo Antagonista program on Wednesday, the 24th.

item.title: Jaques Wagner deixa liderança do governo em "comum acordo" com Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) stepped down as Senate government leader in mutual agreement with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following his targeting in Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police, which investigates alleged irregularities linked to Banco Master. Wagner stated his priority is now to prove his innocence and focus on Lula’s re-election, Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues’ re-election, and his own Senate re-election alongside Rui Costa. His exit was sought by government and PT allies to prevent the scandal from tarnishing Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Capacitação para candidatas das Eleições 2026 está com inscrições abertas
item.description: Registrations are now open for the 30th edition of the Electoral Candidates Course – Brazil Edition, an initiative by the OEA and Anadep with support from the TSE, offering in-person and virtual training for female candidates nationwide ahead of the 2026 General Elections. The program will be held in a hybrid format, with in-person sessions in Brasília on July 8–9 and a virtual session on July 17, providing 480 spots for the virtual track and up to 100 for the in-person track. The opening ceremony will be streamed publicly via the TSE’s YouTube channel and TV Justiça, while all other activities will be reserved exclusively for selected participants.

item.title: Michelle diz que Flávio Bolsonaro a desrespeitou e humilhou em ligação
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and humiliation in a phone call after she opposed the PL's articulation in Ceará to form an alliance with Ciro Gomes. She said he spoke rudely, questioned her political experience, and suggested she stay out of party decisions. Michelle argues that Bolsonaro supporters should back Eduardo Girão for governor of Ceará, calling an alliance with Ciro Gomes incoherent given his past criticism of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Jaques Wagner deixa Palácio da Alvorada após reunião com Lula
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) left the Palácio da Alvorada after meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) on Wednesday, the 24th, at 4:40 PM. The meeting lasted approximately two hours.

item.title: Flávio, CNI e Klabin: saiba quem quer falar em audiência do tarifaço
item.description: The USTR public hearing on Brazil’s trade practices received 85 participation requests, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and representatives from CNI, Klabin, and Bauducco. The Lula government will not send representatives, while CNI advocates direct negotiation to avoid tariffs that could disrupt supply chains. Companies argue there is no trade imbalance justifying new tariffs and that such measures would raise costs for U.S. importers and harm domestic industries.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro fala em ‘punhalada’ e explica por que ainda não apoiou Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro explained in a video that she did not support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid after feeling humiliated by him and his brothers when she criticized the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. She said Flávio publicly rebuked her, spoke to her rudely, and never sought reconciliation despite visiting her home weekly. Michelle blames Ciro Gomes for Jair Bolsonaro’s ineligibility and wants the PL to back Eduardo Girão in the state.

item.title: Portal do TSE passa a exibir votos de processos pautados para julgamento em lista nas sessões presenciais
item.description: Starting this Wednesday (24), the TSE began publishing the rapporteurs' votes on processes scheduled for judgment in the plenary list on its portal, allowing lawyers and interested parties to track their positions from the start of in-person sessions. Previously, these votes were shared only among justices and made public only after deliberations began. The feature does not apply to cases not included in the judgment list.

item.title: Confira a pauta de julgamentos do TSE desta quinta-feira (25)
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday (25) on 17 cases, including appeals concerning alleged gender quota fraud in Podemos' state deputy candidacies in Amapá during the 2022 General Elections, with a vista vote by Minister Dias Toffoli, following TRE-AP decisions that dismissed Aimes over abuse of power. Other highlights include the rejection of the PL's financial accounts in Piauí (2022) and the conviction of a Sergipe city council candidate for voter bribery in the 2020 municipal elections.

item.title: TSE convoca sessão extraordinária virtual para julgamento de 28 processos
item.description: The TSE convened an extraordinary virtual session to judge 28 cases of negative anticipatory electoral propaganda related to the 2026 General Elections. The session will take place this Thursday (25) from 00:00 to 23:59, with rapporteurs Kassio Nunes Marques, André Mendonça, and Estela Aranha. The docket will be published on the TSE Portal by 8:00 PM on Wednesday (24).

item.title: Governo Zema em MG deu isenção fiscal de R$ 2,28 milhões à Eletrozema
item.description: The Minas Gerais government, under Governor Romeu Zema (Novo), granted a R$ 2.28 million tax exemption to Eletrozema, a company owned by the former governor’s family, starting in June 2024. The benefit was disclosed via the state’s Transparency Portal, which showed the government foregone nearly R$ 20 billion in ICMS exemptions during Zema’s tenure. Zema defended the measure, stating the company’s special tax regime has existed since 2008 and is a legal tool to stimulate economic development, attract investment, and preserve competitiveness.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro posta vídeo de IA com 'resgate' de Neymar após fala de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) shared an AI-generated video on X depicting an artificial version of himself 'rescuing' Neymar in a military aircraft after President Lula joked about the player working from 'home office'. The video, posted hours before Brazil's match against Scotland in the World Cup, aims to defend Neymar and criticize Lula, reinforcing the senator's support for the footballer. Despite the TSE's ban on deep fakes in electoral campaigns, the video was shared on Flávio Bolsonaro's official profile, who is a pre-candidate for president in 2026.

item.title: Alemão desbanca Messi em ranking de ataque da Copa
item.description: German striker Deniz Undav leads the 2026 World Cup attack ranking with a score of 8.93, ahead of Lionel Messi (8.36) and Kylian Mbappé (8.08). Brazilian Vinícius Júnior ranks fifth at 7.17, behind Norway’s Erling Haaland (7.25). Canada’s Derek Cornelius tops the defense ranking (7.50), and France’s Michael Olise leads creativity (8.13).

item.title: Como a Petrobras pode aproveitar a mudança na estratégia do México para o petróleo
item.description: Petrobras and Pemex signed a cooperation agreement to explore synergies in pre-salt exploration, refining, petrochemicals, and clean energy, driven by the geopolitical alliance between Lula and Sheinbaum amid rising right-wing movements in Latin America and pressure from Trump. The partnership aims to strengthen energy sovereignty and economic resilience for both nations, particularly in the Gulf of Mexico. The initiative reflects a shared strategy to deepen South-South cooperation in strategic sectors amid an adverse external environment.

item.title: Fachin pede análise técnica antes de decidir sobre relator de caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin requested technical analysis before deciding whether to reassign the investigation into funds sent by Flávio Bolsonaro for the 'Dark Horse' film to André Mendonça or keep it with Alexandre de Moraes. The Prosecutor General’s Office advocated reassignment to Mendonça, as the matter is already under his supervision in a separate case involving Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro. The controversy arose after a criminal complaint by Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), following Intercept Brasil revelations that Flávio sought R$ 134 million from Vorcaro, with R$ 61 million transferred to a U.S.-linked fund tied to Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Jaques Wagner após líder do governo ser alvo de operação da PF sobre Master
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Senate government leader Jaques Wagner after Wagner was targeted in the 9th phase of the PF’s Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates alleged bribes from Banco Master in exchange for parliamentary favors. Luly urged Wagner to voluntarily step down to defend himself, aiming to protect government stability amid corruption and money laundering allegations.

item.title: Rio vira ponto estratégico para as eleições presidenciais e entra na mira de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Rio de Janeiro has become a strategic focal point in the 2026 presidential pre-campaigns, with the PT believing it can achieve better results due to the wear-down of right-aligned former governors and Eduardo Paes’ support, while the PL bets on Flávio Bolsonaro and bolsonarismo’s strength in the state’s conservative interior. The absence of Douglas Ruas as interim governor—following Castro’s resignation and Bacellar’s investigation—has weakened the PL’s control of the state machinery, favoring Lula and Paes’ alignment.

item.title: Flávio parabeniza Keiko Fujimori e cita combate ao 'narcoterrorismo' em mais uma vitória da direita na América do Sul
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) congratulated Keiko Fujimori on her victory in the Peruvian presidential election, emphasizing regional cooperation against 'narcoterrorism' and celebrating a 'new right-wing cycle' in South America. He had previously praised the win of Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia, a Trump-backed candidate. Fujimori won with 50.11% of the vote against Roberto Sánchez's 49.88%, with 99.9% of ballots counted.

item.title: Lula e Jaques Wagner estão reunidos agora
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Jaques Wagner are meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada to decide whether Wagner will retain his position as government leader in the Senate. The meeting takes place one week after Wagner was targeted in a Federal Police operation over alleged ties to Augusto Lima, business partner of Daniel Vorcaro. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Sociedade Brasileira de Computação inspeciona códigos-fonte dos sistemas das Eleições 2026
item.description: The Brazilian Computing Society (SBC) inspected the source code of the TSE's electoral systems in preparation for the 2026 General Elections. The review, part of the Democratic Transparency Cycle, covered operating systems, voting software, transmission, tallying, and encryption mechanisms, with the coordinator praising Brazil's system as 'the most sophisticated in the world'. The source code was opened one year in advance to allow thorough validation by political parties, oversight bodies, and academia.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pega avião para resgatar Neymar após fala de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used an AI-generated video to attack President Lula, portraying himself as a Brazilian Air Force pilot rescuing Neymar after Lula called him the 'first home office call-up in the world'. Released hours before Brazil’s 2026 World Cup match against Scotland, the video highlights Neymar’s longstanding ties to Bolsonarismo, including receiving a medal from Jair Bolsonaro and urging votes for him in 2022.

item.title: ‘Lulômetro’ do Real Time Big Data mostra impacto do caso Master para presidente
item.description: The 'Lulômetro' by Real Time Big Data detected a decline in President Lula's popularity due to the Banco Master scandal's association with the PT, though the impact is less severe than that faced by Flávio Bolsonaro, as the accusations do not directly target him. Despite this setback, Lula had been showing gradual recovery in approval ratings, with government disapproval falling from over 40% to 38%, driven by economic measures like Desenrola and the proposed workweek reduction. The firm's director warned that further developments in the scandal could influence voting intentions in the 2026 election.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': Fachin pede análise técnica antes de definir relator do caso
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin requested technical clarification from the court's staff regarding the distribution of the case investigating Jair Bolsonaro and his sons Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro over alleged irregularities linked to the film 'Dark Horse'. The request aims to ensure transparency before appointing a rapporteur for the case.

item.title: A vitória parcial no STF de general que tramou assassinar Lula, Alckmin e Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes partially approved a request by retired General Mario Fernandes to pay a R$ 194,520 fine imposed for his role in a coup plot, reducing the installment plan from 60 to 36 months. Although Fernandes claimed only R$ 4,100 remained after expenses, Moraes set monthly payments at R$ 5,400 (two minimum wages), citing Fernandes’ R$ 23,000 monthly reserve military income as sufficient to maintain the fine’s punitive and deterrent purpose.

item.title: Zema reafirma crítica a Flávio após áudios com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema reaffirmed his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following the leak of audio involving former banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating he has no regrets and cannot applaud someone who associated with 'that criminal banker'. The Novo party’s presidential pre-candidate emphasized his consistency and said his stance remains unchanged.

item.title: ‘Que tal você ser minha vice?’, diz Flávio a deputada Bia Kicis
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate, said he is considering naming Deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) as his running mate for the 2026 election. He praised her preparation, conservative stance, and ability to negotiate across political lines, saying he wants public opinion on the idea. Flávio also noted he has spoken with other PL women, including Júlia Zanatta, Simone Marquetto, Tereza Cristina, and Clarissa Tércio, in his search for a vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: Nikolas ironiza fala de Lula sobre honestidade na política
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) mocked President Lula's statement about honesty in politics, publicly agreeing with the petista by saying 'finally he told the truth'. He used clips of Lula's speeches on social media to criticize him, repeating a strategy previously used, such as in the case of Lula's comment about Neymar, where Ferreira contrasted the athlete's injury-related absence with Lula's disqualification due to a judicial conviction.

item.title: Ministro do PT diz que Lula deveria tirar Jaques Wagner da liderança do governo
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho of the PT party said on Wednesday that President Lula should remove Senator Jaques Wagner from his position as Senate government leader, amid suspicions of Wagner's involvement with Banco Master. The statement reflects internal PT tensions amid ongoing investigations into alleged financial irregularities.

item.title: Crusoé: Janja reclama da falta de atenção da imprensa
item.description: Brazil's First Lady Janja, wife of President Lula, complained about the lack of attention from Brazilian media, saying she feels more respected by international press. In an interview on the PT's YouTube channel, she mentioned at one point wanting to return to São Paulo with her dogs. The complaint highlights a perceived undervaluation of the First Lady's role in national media coverage.

item.title: Republicanos avalia retomar laços com Flávio e acena com vice enquanto tenta se descolar de caso Digimais, alvo da PF
item.description: The Republicans party is reconsidering its distancing from Flávio Bolsonaro, potentially re-engaging to support his presidential bid while attempting to disentangle itself from the Digimais Bank fraud scandal tied to the Universal Church. Party leader Marcos Pereira is advocating for economist Daniella Marques as Flávio’s running mate, citing her tenure at Caixa and in Bolsonaro’s economic team. Despite denying direct ties to the Universal Church, the party faces internal divisions between pro-Lula and bolsonarist factions, with no final campaign strategy yet decided.

item.title: Governo Zema deu isenção de R$ 2 mi à Eletrozema
item.description: By judicial order, the Minas Gerais government disclosed the list of companies receiving fiscal incentives under Romeu Zema's administration. Eletrozema received a tax exemption of R$ 2 million. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Com direita em alta, governo nega que Lula esteja isolado na região
item.description: The election of right-wing presidents in Colombia and Peru has sparked speculation about Lula’s regional isolation, but the Brazilian government denies this, emphasizing the continuity of dialogue and bilateral cooperation. Colombian analysts note that outsider candidate Abelardo de la Espriella’s victory reflects a desire for change, yet does not break institutional ties with Brazil. Lula maintains active engagement with regional leaders despite the rise of conservative forces.

item.title: Governo prepara programa para renegociar dívidas de MEIs
item.description: The Lula government is preparing a debt renegotiation program for MEIs (Micro Individual Entrepreneurs), offering discounts of up to 70% on debts of up to R$20,000, with installment plans extending up to 12 years and minimum monthly payments of R$25. Simultaneously, a bill will be sent to Congress to raise the MEI’s annual revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$140,000 by 2028, with an intermediate target of R$110,000 by 2027, estimated to have a fiscal impact of R$2 billion per year.

item.title: Quem são os eleitores que estão ajudando Lula a manter a dianteira contra Flávio
item.description: Lula maintains a lead over Flávio Bolsonaro due to strong support from unemployed voters not seeking work, public servants, Northeasterners, students, and those with elementary education. These groups show advantages ranging from 13 to 39 percentage points, offsetting general government disapproval. The Datafolha survey of 2,004 voters shows Lula at 41% versus Flávio’s 31%, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ‘resgata’ Neymar em vídeo de IA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) published an AI-generated video simulating a 'rescue' of footballer Neymar Jr., in response to comments by President Lula that were perceived as mocking during a public event in Minas Gerais. The video, shared as part of the PL pre-candidate's communication strategy, frames Neymar as a victim of government attacks and reinforces a narrative defending public figures aligned with the opposition. The AI-generated content creates a fictional scene blending sports, politics, and symbolism of protection.

item.title: Dois presos, duas medidas: os critérios para o STF definir os destinos de Vorcaro e Bolsonaro
item.description: The STF is split between its two chambers in handling two politically sensitive cases: Alexandre de Moraes will decide whether Jair Bolsonaro remains under house arrest after a security guard was found with a firearm linked to the ex-president, while André Mendonça will rule on whether Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, should be transferred from the PF’s superintendency to a prison. The rulings hinge on health concerns, institutional risks, and procedural strategy, with significant implications for the electoral year and internal power dynamics within the Court.

item.title: Ministro do Trabalho diz que, se fosse Lula, substituiria Jaques Wagner na liderança do governo
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho (PT) said he would replace Jaques Wagner as government leader in the Senate if he were President Lula, referencing the Federal Police operation tied to the Master case and the seizure of $49,000 in cash linked to the senator. Marinho emphasized that the final decision rests with Lula, while expressing personal respect for Wagner and citing Fernando Haddad’s testimony defending him. The remarks came ahead of an expected meeting between Lula and Wagner to determine the senator’s future in the leadership role.

item.title: Por que duas reuniões de Lula nesta quarta serão decisivas em seu plano de reeleição
item.description: Lula holds two strategic meetings this Wednesday to shape his 2026 re-election path: one with Jaques Wagner to assess his Senate leadership amid a PF investigation into alleged Master Bank bribes, and another with Fernando Haddad and Márcio França to finalize São Paulo’s electoral strategy, including the possibility of França running as a standalone candidate to force a runoff against Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: o Piti de Erika Hilton pelo fundão eleitoral
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program highlighted federal deputy Erika Hilton's (PSOL-SP) public frustration over the distribution of electoral fund resources, as she demanded greater advantage from her party's national leadership. The segment also touched on controversial remarks made by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at a recent event, without specifying the content. The main focus was internal tension within the PSOL regarding the allocation of electoral funds.

item.title: Luiz Marinho diz que trocaria Jaques Wagner, mas que Lula decide
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho said he would replace Senator Jaques Wagner as Senate government leader, but stressed the decision rests with President Lula. He praised Wagner’s performance but suggested stepping down could aid his defense after being targeted in PF’s Operation Compliance Zero. Lula and Wagner meet Wednesday, their first personal contact since the operation, with Wagner’s future still uncertain.

item.title: Lula apoia candidatura própria do PT em Minas e aumenta pressão para ex-prefeita concorrer
item.description: President Lula signaled his preference for a standalone PT candidacy in Minas Gerais, increasing pressure on the former mayor to run. The state, with the second-largest electorate in Brazil, is considered pivotal for Lula’s 2026 reelection bid. The move aims to strengthen the party’s base in a historically challenging state for the left.

item.title: Fachin defende reforma no Judiciário e quer proposta até novembro
item.description: Supreme Court President Minister Edson Fachin is leading a working group to draft a judiciary reform proposal by November 15, 2026, with a final deadline of December 19. The reform aims to simplify procedures, reduce judicialization, govern AI use, update careers, and strengthen transparency, ethics, and integrity across the justice system, including the judiciary, Public Ministry, public defenders, and legal profession.

item.title: Marinho: Wagner deve deixar liderança do governo para "se defender"
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho suggested that Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) should step down from his government leadership role in the Senate to better defend himself against allegations from Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates alleged fraud at Banco Master. Marinho said the decision rests with President Lula but expressed personal confidence in Wagner’s innocence, citing his exemplary conduct. The investigation includes evidence linking Wagner to legislative actions benefiting Banco Master and allegations of undue advantages, including a R$ 2.5 million apartment in Salvador.

item.title: Mágoa após entrevista e ‘vácuo político’: nova crise arrasta Lula e preocupa governo
item.description: President Lula is set to meet with Senator Jaques Wagner to discuss the senator’s potential departure as government leader in the Senate following a Federal Police operation targeting him. Wagner seeks a gradual transition during the July recess to avoid the appearance of guilt, while Lula’s allies urge an immediate decision, warning that prolonged uncertainty is damaging the government’s image and could hurt Lula’s re-election campaign.

item.title: O que você precisa saber sobre o novo Banco Nacional de Celulares com Restrição
item.description: President Lula signed a decree making the Celular Seguro project a permanent public policy, creating the National Bank of Restricted Cellphones (BNCR), managed by the Ministry of Justice and integrated into Sinesp. The platform allows free IMEI-based checks to determine if a phone is reported stolen or lost, returning only 'No restriction' or 'With restriction' to protect privacy under LGPD. The BNCR aims to reduce the trade of stolen devices and support police investigations and recovery efforts.

item.title: STM rejeita afastar ministro em caso de patente de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Military Tribunal unanimously rejected Jair Bolsonaro’s defense request to remove Minister Francisco Joseli Parente Camelo from a proceeding that could result in the loss of Bolsonaro’s rank as a retired army captain. President Minister Maria Elizabeth Rocha stated the defense offered no new arguments and that Joseli’s public remarks were generic, not indicating bias or prejudgment. The case, opened after Bolsonaro’s STF conviction for attempting a coup, assesses whether he is unworthy or incompatible with military officership.

item.title: Operação contra Jaques Wagner devolve bola para bolsonarismo e impulsiona tema corrupção nas redes
item.description: The Federal Police's Operation Compliance Zero, targeting Lula's Senate leader Jaques Wagner, bolstered the Bolsonarist narrative on corruption and took the initiative away from the government in digital discourse. Corruption-related social media posts surged 20-fold in one week, according to Instituto Democracia em Xeque, solidifying the right's dominance in national politics, foreign policy, and corruption debates. The left lost its ability to set the agenda with favorable topics, while the right leveraged the operation to mobilize its base.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro parabeniza Keiko Fujimori, presidente eleita do Peru
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) congratulated Keiko Fujimori, Peru's elected president, emphasizing the importance of South American cooperation to combat transnational narco-terrorism and promote economic freedom. He stated that her right-leaning government represents hope for peace, progress, and stability in the region. Fujimori secured an irreversible lead with 50.11% of the vote versus Sánchez's 49.88%, despite opposition allegations of fraud.

item.title: Gilmar defende condenação de Zambelli em novo processo de extradição e envia garantias à Itália
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes has submitted information to Italian authorities to support a new extradition request for former deputy Carla Zambelli, emphasizing the legality of her conviction for illegal firearm possession and unlawful coercion with a weapon in 2022. He also provided guarantees requested by Italy, including serving her sentence in Brasília's women's penitentiary and access to legal counsel and diplomatic representation. The new request will be reviewed after Italy rejected an earlier extradition tied to the CNJ system invasion, citing alleged bias by Justice Alexandre de Moraes.
